criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
evidence: Purdue housing identifies FUSE at 720 Northwestern Avenue and lists the ground-level retail, heated parking, and private interior quad. Identity is well supported; the model footprint is inherited from a legacy massing asset and has no independently matched GIS polygon or survey.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
evidence: Mapletree pin coordinate converts under modular/AGENTS.md local approximation to X=-66.0 m, Y=632.7 m. Saved shell center is X=-65.8 m, Y=602.6 m (delta 0.2, -30.1 m); the approximate pin is not documented as a surveyed centroid. Saved shell dimensions are 82.47 x 82.30 x 16.00 m, but no independent footprint, orientation, or dimension comparison supports them.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
evidence: Pierce Engineers source snapshot states seven total levels: four apartment levels above one commercial level and two below-grade parking levels. The model visually represents a retail podium and four residential levels, but omits the below-grade parking. Its 16 m height is inherited and explicitly not independently measured; the flat roof is not verified by an elevation or plan.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
evidence: Preview shows repeated upper window bays, brick piers, light spandrels, retail glazing, and an interior court; the submitted visual-reference source is a LoopNet listing but no raw snapshot is saved. Evidence record calls facade cadence and sign location schematic. No clearly modeled or source-verified entrance is documented.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
evidence: Saved Asset_massing_fuse_39cf4b5 collection reopened with 9 objects and a collection-only probe exported and reopened successfully. Four image texture paths are relative to the project and point into materials/textures/red_brick; they are not packed. Evidence includes two previews and raw Purdue/Pierce snapshots, but the Mapletree snapshot is an HTTP 405 error text file, and source metadata/footprint evidence is incomplete.

evidence.detail: Independently opened with Blender 4.5.15; collection name, nine objects, dimensions, transforms, modifiers and image paths inspected.
Structured source and uncertainty record reviewed.
Raw official Purdue housing source snapshot.
Raw source snapshot supporting seven-level program and 420,000 sq ft.
Snapshot attempt records HTTP 405; it contains no usable source page.
Directly inspected exterior preview: courtyard opening, flat roof, schematic facade, no visible entrance.
Directly inspected plan preview: square perimeter and centered approximate courtyard.
Inspected generation logic and its explicit inherited/estimated geometry notes.
Manifest retains kind=massing, expected collection and bounds; its object_count/source objects still describe one legacy FUSE object, while saved collection has nine.
Temporary collection-only export probe outside repository, reopened successfully with expected collection and nine members.

findings: FAIL: 4.5/10 is below the 8/10 passing standard; the asset should not be accepted as independently validated.
Footprint identity is not established geometrically. Obtain a matching authoritative GIS footprint or survey and compare wall footprint, orientation and dimensions.

Coordinate pin is only approximate: the converted Mapletree point and shell center differ by about 30 m north-south; resolve against an identifiable building centroid or footprint before claiming placement accuracy.
Height and floor program have partial source support, but 16 m is inherited and the two underground parking levels are not represented.
Facade details are mostly schematic, no entrance is identified, and the LoopNet visual reference has no saved raw snapshot. Add inspectable dated imagery/elevation evidence if available.
Manifest object_count and objects fields remain stale relative to the nine-object saved export collection; update by coordinator when integrating the building.
Texture references are relative but not packed; portability depends on preserving the project texture folder.
